insight: Runs asynchronously in its own cloud sandbox aimed at whole tickets, not autocomplete — and the model and harness are closed.
name: Devin
tagline: Autonomous software engineer agent. Plans, codes, ships from a prompt.
description: Cognition's hosted SWE agent. Operates inside its own sandbox with a browser, terminal, and editor — plans the work, writes the code, and submits a PR. Aimed at long-horizon tickets rather than tab-completions.
